gloss: to spark debate; to be controversial; to provoke discussion

definitions.gloss: to spark debate; to be controversial; to provoke discussion
definitions.explanation: To cause or invite debate, discussion, or controversy. Describes a topic, statement, or action that generates differing opinions and public discussion.

notes:
A set expression using ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧ (debate, discussion) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call, to invite). The verb ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ here means "to invite" or "to attract," not "to call someone."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is sparking debate (ongoing)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to spark major debate
- ⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to spark debate for and against

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{物議|ぶつぎ}を{醸|かも}す→物議を醸す：09980_butsugiwokamosu⟧: to cause controversy — stronger negative connotation
- ⟦{波紋|はもん}→波紋：10553_hamon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to cause ripples, create waves — implies spreading impact
- ⟦{論争|ろんそう}→論争：03786_ronsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす→巻き起こす：30744_makiokosu⟧: to stir up controversy — more confrontational
